name: table
behavior: Native table semantics (table / rowgroup / row / columnheader / cell; caption names the table). APG grid pattern applies only when cell navigation or row selection makes it interactive.

parts.note: wrapped in an overflow container for horizontal scroll — wrapper is a recipe, not a part
bottom rule separates header from body

parts.statesNote: hover only when rows are interactive; selected uses interaction-selected / on-interaction-selected

parts.note: numeric columns use type-data (tabular numerals) with end alignment; text columns use type-body
leading column hosting a checkbox per row plus a select-all header checkbox (indeterminate when partially selected)

anatomyNotes: size binds row height to control-height-*; themes with a density axis freeze it there. Zebra striping and sticky headers are recipe options on row/header-row, not anatomy.
